response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile Staff-level engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems, and a CS bachelor's degree, but his resume shows almost no direct evidence of the core GenAI requirements: no Python, no mention of vector databases, RAG, LLM evaluation/observability, or cloud AI platform design. His only AI-adjacent experience is a brief, recent stint (since April 2025) touching MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling, which is far short of the 8+ years of AI-driven solution development the role requires.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level engineering experience across diverse stacks and domains
Current exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No listed Python experience, and minimal demonstrated AI/ML or GenAI project history
No evidence of vector database, RAG architecture, or multi-agent framework (LangGraph/CrewAI) experience
No indication of leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions or designing AI systems on major cloud platforms

key_factors.factor: Minimal AI tenure vs required 8+ years in AI-driven solutions
Strong general staff-level engineering and leadership background
